name: Shattered Sanctum
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands.
{T}: Add {W} or {B}.
blocked_sentences: This land enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands.

needs.what: a `condition` field on the `self_enters_tapped` replacement, evaluated as the permanent enters, so the permanent enters untapped when it holds. The three printed shapes across this cycle are: a subtype test over permanents you control ("a Mountain or a Plains"), a count of other lands you control ("two or more other lands"), and a count of basic lands you control ("two or more basic lands") -- so the condition must reach a filtered count over your battlefield, with `other` excluding the entering permanent itself.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `ReplacementModel` (cards/schema.py) has only `event`, `modify`, `counter` and `amount` -- there is no condition field -- and `zones._enter_battlefield` applies `self_enters_tapped` unconditionally. `proxy._enters_tapped` therefore emits the note "enters tapped unconditionally; the printed condition is not modelled" and the card is a strict downgrade of the printed one. `evaluate_condition` in engine/effects/conditions.py is the standalone evaluator this needs and already exists; nothing calls it from the ETB path.
